title: Driver killed, two injured as tree falls on autorickshaw in Idukki
content: ​Idukki: An autorickshaw driver died, while two passengers sustained injuries after a tree collapsed onto the moving vehicle at Santhanpara in Idukki district. The victim was Vijayan, a native of Santhanpara. ​The incident occurred around 8:00 pm on Saturday near the Chinnakkada bridge in Santhanpara. According to sources, an electric autorickshaw carrying three people, including the driver, was hit by the falling tree. ​Vijayan, who suffered severe injuries in the impact, was rushed to a private hospital in Rajakkad, but succumbed to his injuries during treatment. The two passengers sustained minor injuries and are currently out of danger.
